analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for 4 consecutive sessions. Volume ratio is up to 1.73x the 5-day average, but price is consolidating between the swing support at $1.33 and resistance at $1.39. ADX at 27.1 suggests a trend, but unclear DI indicators require further confirmation.
